column4: Platform Crowd Risk Prediction and Early Warning System for Railway Platforms
column14: This patent proposes a Crowd Risk Prediction and Early Warning System for railway platforms using advanced AI and real-time data analytics. The system integrates computer vision, sensor data, and machine learning algorithms to monitor passenger density, movement patterns, and potential risk situations such as overcrowding or stampedes. It predicts crowd-related risks in advance and generates timely alerts for authorities to take preventive actions. The system enhances passenger safety, improves crowd management efficiency, and supports smart railway infrastructure through automated monitoring and decision-making.

column4: Artificial Intelligence-Based System for Early Lung Nodule Detection and Risk Prediction Using CT Scan Images
column14: The proposed invention is an Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based software system designed for the early detection and risk prediction of lung nodules using chest CT scan images. The system receives CT images, performs image quality assessment and enhancement, segments the lung region, detects candidate nodules, extracts relevant features, and classifies the detected nodules using AI techniques. It further estimates the malignancy risk and automatically generates a structured diagnostic report with confidence scores and risk categories. The invention integrates all processing stages into a single workflow, reducing manual effort and improving diagnostic efficiency. It supports standard DICOM images and can be integrated with existing hospital PACS and Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems. The proposed system assists radiologists in making timely and informed clinical decisions, improves workflow consistency, reduces reporting time, and supports early diagnosis of lung diseases through an intelligent, user-friendly, and cost-effective computer-aided diagnostic solution.

column4: A Scalable Apache Spark-Based Intelligent Credit Risk Prediction System Using Optimized Stacking Ensemble Machine Learning
column14: The present invention relates to an intelligent credit risk prediction system that assists banks and financial institutions in making accurate and timely loan approval decisions. The system analyzes applicant financial information, including credit history, income, employment details, loan information, and other relevant financial attributes, to assess the probability of loan default. It employs a scalable distributed computing framework integrated with an optimized stacking ensemble machine learning approach to efficiently process large-scale financial datasets and generate reliable credit risk predictions. Based on the predicted risk score, applicants are classified into predefined risk categories to support informed lending decisions. The proposed system improves prediction accuracy, reduces processing time, minimizes manual intervention, and enhances consistency in credit evaluation. It is suitable for deployment in banks, NBFCs, fintech companies, insurance organizations, and digital lending platforms. The invention enables efficient, scalable, and data-driven credit risk assessment, thereby reducing financial losses due to loan defaults while improving overall operational efficiency and decision-making.

column4: AI-Based Multi-Level Attention System for Corn Leaf Disease Detection and Severity Assessment

The system receives digital images of corn leaves captured using a smartphone, camera, drone, or other imaging device and automatically analyses them to identify diseases such as Common Rust, Gray Leaf Spot, and Northern Leaf Blight. The invention performs image quality assessment, image enhancement, disease region identification, disease classification, and severity estimation in an integrated workflow. Based on the diagnosis, the system provides crop management recommendations and generates a user-friendly report for farmers and agricultural professionals. The invention reduces dependence on manual inspection and laboratory testing while enabling rapid and reliable disease diagnosis under field conditions. It improves crop health monitoring, minimizes yield losses, supports timely intervention, and promotes sustainable farming practices. The invention is suitable for deployment in farms, agricultural research institutions, mobile platforms, and intelligent decision-support systems for modern agriculture.

column4: SMARTMARK – TRANSFORMER-BASED REAL-TIME ATTENDANCE TRACKING WITH LIVENESS DETECTION
column14:
The invention titled SMARTMARK – Transformer-Based Real-Time Attendance Tracking with Liveness Detection discloses an advanced biometric authentication framework designed for 
secure, contactless, and privacy-preserving attendance verification. The system integrates a spatio-temporal transformer neural network for analyzing continuous facial 
video sequences, enabling accurate identity recognition even under varying environmental conditions. It incorporates multi-modal liveness detection combining RGB, 
infrared, and depth imaging with physiological and behavioral biometrics such as micro-expressions, pulse patterns, and thermal gradients to differentiate live human 
subjects from spoofed inputs. The system further employs privacy-preserving protocols including zero-knowledge proof, homomorphic encryption, and differential 
privacy to ensure that biometric data remains non-reconstructible and confidential. Real-time operation is achieved through distributed edge computing and federated 
learning architectures, allowing sub-100-millisecond verification latency while continuously improving accuracy across diverse demographics. The invention ensures 
fairness, robustness against adversarial attacks, and seamless integration with existing attendance systems, representing a transformative leap in secure identity 
management and authentication technology.

column4: System And Method for Emotionally Safe Language Scoring in Skincare Marketing
column14:
The present invention relates to artificial intelligence-based content 
analysis systems for evaluating emotional safety in skincare and beauty marketing communications. It addresses the problem of emotionally manipulative language 
such as shame-inducing or fear-based messaging that negatively impacts consumer psychological well-being. The disclosed system receives marketing content in text, 
audio, or visual formats, preprocesses the input, and employs transformer-based language models integrated with emotion lexicons to detect harmful emotional patterns. 
A scoring engine calculates a Lexical Sensitivity Index (LSI) from 0 to 100, indicating the emotional risk level. When the LSI exceeds a defined threshold, a rewrite 
generator produces ethically optimized, body-positive alternatives using instruction-tuned large language models. Results are presented via a dashboard or API, 
enabling integration with marketing workflows. Principal use includes ethical content evaluation and rewriting in beauty and wellness advertising.

column4: SmartPulse-AI Neural-Assisted Latency Optimization for Industrial Sensor Networks
column14: This invention presents "SmartPulse-AI," a system and method for proactive latency optimization in Industrial Sensor Networks (ISNs). It solves the critical limitation of prior reactive systems by introducing a Neural-Assisted Optimization Engine. This core component utilizes a lightweight Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural network to continuously analyze network and process telemetry, enabling it to forecast latency spikes and congestion events before they occur. Based on these predictions, the system proactively computes optimal data routing paths via a Dynamic Path Computation Unit and intelligently adjusts data stream priorities through a Context-Aware Priority Manager. These optimized commands are then actuated directly onto the network infrastructure. By shifting from a reactive to a predictive paradigm, SmartPulse-AI autonomously prevents latency, ensuring the reliability and real-time performance essential for industrial automation, thereby overcoming the brittleness and delays inherent in static, rule-based prior art.

column4: BioSentient: Federated AI-WSN Model for Privacy-Preserving Health Data Analytics
column14: The present invention discloses BioSentient, a Federated Artificial Intelligence and Wireless Sensor Network (AI-WSN) based system and method for privacy-preserving health data analytics. The invention integrates distributed biosensor nodes, edge computing modules, and a federated learning coordinator to enable real-time monitoring and intelligent analysis of physiological parameters without centralizing sensitive health data. Each sensor node captures physiological signals such as ECG, heart rate, SpO₂, temperature, and motion data, and performs local preprocessing, feature extraction, and on-device model training. The locally computed model parameters, instead of raw data, are encrypted and securely transmitted to a federated learning coordinator, where global model aggregation is performed using privacy-preserving protocols such as homomorphic encryption and differential privacy. The aggregated global model is redistributed to all participating nodes, enhancing prediction accuracy through continuous learning while ensuring full data confidentiality. An adaptive edge intelligence framework dynamically manages communication, computation, and energy consumption across the network. Optionally, a blockchain-based verification layer ensures data integrity, traceability, and auditability of model updates. The invention further includes a context-aware analytics dashboard providing real-time visualization, anomaly detection, and health alerts to authorized medical professionals. The BioSentient system thus provides a secure, scalable, and energy-efficient architecture for distributed healthcare analytics, eliminating the risks of centralized data exposure while enabling continuous, intelligent, and personalized health monitoring.

column4: MediTwin Predictive Digital Twin for Personalized Therapy Simulation
column14: The present invention discloses "MediTwin," a system and method for creating a predictive digital twin to simulate personalized medical therapies. It solves the critical problem of trial-and-error medicine by enabling proactive, patient-specific forecasting. The system electronically aggregates a patient's multi-modal data—including genomics, medical imaging, EHR history, and real-time biosensor feeds—to instantiate a dynamic, multi-scale computational model of the patient's physiology. A simulation engine allows clinicians to input proposed therapies and run in-silico trials, predicting quantitative outcomes for efficacy and adverse effects before physical administration. A machine learning calibration engine continuously refines the digital twin by comparing predictions with actual patient outcomes, ensuring increasing accuracy. By enabling direct comparison of treatment strategies on a virtual replica, MediTwin transforms clinical decision-making from a generalized, reactive process into a precision-engineered forecast, aiming to improve patient outcomes and reduce healthcare costs.

column4: A hardware-anchored multi-path signal-coherence computing system using physically isolated buffer-controller circuits and deterministic cross-path divergence resolution
column14: The invention discloses a hardware-anchored multi-path computing system for processing heterogeneous asynchronous data streams. The architecture employs physically isolated buffer- controller hardware modules operating under independent or logically decoupled temporal clocks. Each module includes a dedicated memory partition and fixed-function signal- conditioning logic configured to evaluate signal variance against a stored threshold. A hardware gating circuit suppresses processor interrupts for transient perturbations at the ingress stage, ensuring that only statistically coherent data packets propagate to a central divergence- resolution engine. Benchmarking indicates that the system substantially reduces processor interrupt frequency and end-to-end signal processing latency compared to conventional centralized architectures. The invention is applicable to highvolume industrial sensor fusion and other ultra-low-latency telemetry environments.
